$comment: Ingestion source of truth (SPEC §3). Seeded from docs/research/corpus-viability.md §1. kinds: sinalevi (3-call API, idFichaNorma; vigente version resolved at fetch), hacienda-pdf (Playwright fetch — WAF blocks plain HTTP), cabys (curated dev-relevant subset, task #8), unresolved (official source to locate during ingestion; never ingest secondary commentary). deepLink (#134): audited per source — how deep the official URL can be linked. `articulo` = SINALEVI ficha; the viewer opens one artículo at Informacion?param1=<ficha>&param2=<idVersionNorma>&param3=3&param4=<idArticulo>, and `source.articulos` (artículo number → idArticulo) is harvested at ingestion from the «Ficha Artículo» rail in the full-text payload — _BuscarArticulo answers -1 for our fichas, so the rail is the only mapping. `page` = PDF whose primary text is a page range; the chip appends #page=<first page>. excerpt (#176): inside a page range, the from/to line markers bounding the one artículo the entry claims — required where the range is a reform decree, whose neighbouring pages carry incisos later reforms have superseded; ingestion fails loudly if a marker is missing or ambiguous. `none` = the document root is the deepest honest link, with the reason in that entry's notes. imagesAudited (#177): for entries carrying an IMAGE AUDIT note, every image src a human looked at in that audit — ingestion logs a quiet receipt while the payload stays inside this set, and the full #150 warning naming the new srcs the moment a re-crawl adds one.

documents.title: Ley del Impuesto sobre el Valor Agregado (texto consolidado)
Reglamento de la Ley del Impuesto sobre el Valor Agregado
documents.notes: IMAGE AUDIT (#150): 5 images, all rendered formulas; 2 lose substance no chunk of THIS document carries. (a) Artículo 31 inciso 4) — the bien-de-capital adjustment (Ca₀ − Caᵢ)/4 is image-only, so the text reads «El ajuste en cada año deberá calcularse utilizando la siguiente fórmula:» straight into «Donde:». (b) The retención percentage %RT = FR × (TM/13%) × 1/(1+TM) is image-only; the prose names every input and says it is deflated to exclude the IVA, but not the composition. The other 3 restate adjacent prose verbatim and lose nothing. GAPS CLOSED ELSEWHERE (#176): both artículos are now also ingested from the Gaceta that published them, as `reglamento-iva-bienes-capital` (artículo 31, from the reform decree 43173-H) and `reglamento-iva-retencion-tarjetas` (artículo 41, from Alcance 129) — each carrying the formula as text. This ficha stays the primary, whole-reglamento source and is unaffected; never cite THESE chunks for either computation, cite the companion entry. Why they are separate entries rather than a replacement: SINALEVI's consolidated vigente text is the only source for the other 72 artículos, and no single Gaceta carries the reglamento as it now reads.

documents.title: Reglamento del IVA, artículo 31 — crédito aplicable respecto a bienes de capital

excerpt.from: Artículo 31.- Crédito aplicable respecto a bienes de capital

documents.notes: Closes gap (a) of the #150 audit — see the reglamento-iva note. La Gaceta 193, Alcance 202 del 2021-10-07, which is where decreto ejecutivo 43173-H del 3 de agosto de 2021 was published: SINALEVI's reform note gives only the number and the decree's own date, and a public search for it keeps surfacing 43143-H, so the publication was found by scanning the alcances of 2021 for the decree number (#176). Its artículo 1° quotes the reformed inciso 4) in full, formula included, as selectable text (pdftotext -layout, no OCR) — and that quotation is word-for-word the vigente inciso 4) in the SINALEVI ficha, which is what makes ingesting the 2021 publication safe where ingesting the 2019 one was not. Excerpted rather than page-ranged (#176): the same two pages carry other incisos this decree reformed, and one of them — «46) Seguros de sobrevivencia» — was renumbered to 49) by decreto 44392 del 15 de noviembre de 2023, so a page-granular range would seat a superseded numbering beside vigente chunks. Rige a partir de su publicación (ARTÍCULO 3), hence the effective_date. Deep link page (#134): chips land on page 17, where the decree's quotation of artículo 31 begins inside the 91-page alcance. RESIDUE (#203): pdftotext drops the fraction bar, so the stacked formula flattens to «𝐶𝑎0 ‒ 𝐶𝑎𝑖 4» — the operands and the divisor are in the chunk, the division itself is not spelled out. Better than the silence this replaces, still not unambiguous. SURVEY (#199): the excerpted decree is single-column prose — no rail. Not flagged.

documents.title: Reglamento del IVA, artículo 41 — pagos a cuenta y porcentaje de retención (%RT)

excerpt.from: Artículo 41.- Pagos a cuenta del Impuesto Sobre el Valor Agregado
excerpt.to: Artículo 42.- Determinación, liquidación y pago del impuesto

documents.notes: Closes gap (b) of the #150 audit — see the reglamento-iva note. La Gaceta 108, Alcance 129 del 2019-06-11, the original publication of the reglamento, carries both the %RT formula and the tarifa media it depends on as selectable text. Safe to ingest even though the 2019 alcance as a whole is not: artículo 41 carries no reform note in the vigente SINALEVI text, so its wording is unchanged, and the excerpt is bounded to that artículo alone (#176) so no neighbouring 2019 wording comes with it. effective_date is the reglamento's own vigencia, 2019-07-01. Deep link page (#134): chips land on page 75, where artículo 41 begins inside the 106-page alcance. RESIDUE (#203 for the formulas): the %RT bracket table has two columns, below what layoutTable (#179) can read, so it survives as a run-on line in the chunk — and one bracket wraps, so «90% o menos del 100% de ventas locales, exentas o no sujetas» reads «…exentas o no 1% sujetas», with its rate spliced into the middle of its own condition. The five brackets and their five rates are all there and in order; the wrapped one has to be read carefully; and pdftotext drops the fraction bars, so the formula flattens to «𝑇𝑀 1 𝑃𝑜𝑟𝑐𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑎𝑗𝑒 𝑑𝑒 𝑟𝑒𝑡𝑒𝑛𝑐𝑖ó𝑛 = 𝐹𝑅 ∗ ∗ 13% 1 + 𝑇𝑀» — every operand reaches the chunk, the nesting does not. SURVEY (#199): no rail — the %RT brackets are one line each. The wrapped bracket noted above is split by a blank line pdftotext put inside the row, which is a different fault and one labelRail does not address. Not flagged.

documents.notes: IMAGE AUDIT (#150): 3 images, all rendered formulas, all 3 image-only — and they are the same three the reglamento-renta ficha carries, because this ficha quotes TRANSITORIO I of the Reglamento de la Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta in full under TRANSITORIO XIX. documents.title: Reglamento al Título IV de la Ley 9635 (renta)
Reglamento de la Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta
documents.notes: IMAGE AUDIT (#150): 3 images, all rendered formulas, all 3 image-only — the proration rules in TRANSITORIO I («Disposiciones sobre el Transitorio XIX de la Ley 9635»): tramo de renta and crédito fiscal prorated as (valor del periodo ordinario / 12) × meses del periodo, and impuesto determinado re-annualised as (impuesto 2020 / meses del periodo) × 12. Each chunk keeps «deberán utilizar la siguiente fórmula:» and loses the formula. Not replaced: the rule governs fiscal periods closing 2020-12-31 and pagos parciales for 2021–2023 — spent as of 2026, so ingesting a source for it would add dead law rather than an answerable fact. Never cite this Transitorio for a computation; the rest of the reglamento is unaffected.

documents.title: Tramos del Impuesto sobre la Renta, período fiscal 2026
documents.notes: Annual churn — re-fetch each fiscal year; figures only from this primary decree. RAIL (#199): every bracket table here is two columns — a wide condition and a narrow rate — and the condition wraps over three or four lines with the rate vertically centred beside it, so joining the row spliced the rate into the middle of its own bracket («…mensuales y 15% hasta ¢2.364.000,00…»), the worst place in the corpus for it. labelRail re-reads each row as «condición: tasa». Header rows and the one-line crédito rows are single-line blocks and are left exactly as they were. Deep link none (#134): a whole-file PDF with no artículo→page map — a #page= anchor would be a guess.

documents.title: CCSS — Base Mínima Contributiva (decreto)
documents.notes: Annual churn — verify vigente version each re-crawl; figures only from primary decree. CARRIES NO RATES (#114): the escala contributiva table is a raster image in the SINALEVI payload (image005.png), not markup, so HTML→text extraction cannot recover it — the ingested text jumps from «Establecer la siguiente escala contributiva» to «Notas:». Same for the sibling ficha 82804. The doc is kept for Acuerdos Segundo–Cuarto (how the BMC is adjusted when the minimum wage moves); never cite it for a percentage or a BMC amount — those live in ccss-escala-salud, ccss-escala-ivm and salarios-minimos, ingested from the CCSS actas that transcribe the same tables as text. Deep link articulo (#134) — the acuerdos are numbered artículos in the ficha rail.

documents.title: CCSS — Escala contributiva de trabajadores independientes y asegurados voluntarios, Seguro de IVM
documents.norma: Ficha técnica PE-DAE-1179-2025 (acuerdo Junta Directiva, artículo 4°, sesión 9570)
documents.notes: Carries the IVM rates by income bracket (afiliado 4.16–8.42%, conjunta 9.91% + 1.75% Estado como tal = 11.66% global). Brackets are in SM multiples, so they stay correct across wage decrees — resolve colón amounts via salarios-minimos. Adopted verbatim by the Junta Directiva on 2025-12-18 (9 votos en firme) per artículo 33 and Transitorio XI del Reglamento del Seguro de IVM; rige hasta 2028-12-31, next escalón 2029 — re-crawl then. Ingested from the sesión's anexos zip because SINALEVI publishes CCSS escala acuerdos as raster images (#114). Deep link none (#134): the official URL is a zip, so the browser downloads it — no fragment reaches the PDF inside. RAIL (#199): the ficha is a two-column form — a narrow left rail of field names (Tema, Subtema, CONSIDERANDO, PROPUESTAS DE ACUERDO, Técnica, Financiera) beside the body — so joining a block's lines dropped each label into the middle of the sentence next to it, and put «ACUERDO» between two bullets of one list, splitting «Estado (Cuota complementaria)» from «Estado como Tal» — the two concepts #179 exists to keep apart. labelRail re-reads those blocks as «label: body». Two residues a reader should know about: the «Responsable de la presentación» cell swallows the «2. Sinopsis» heading below it, because pdftotext leaves no blank line between them, and «Antecedentes» — whose cell spans a page break — stays a one-word paragraph rather than prefixing the text it labels. IMAGE AUDIT (#175): the gradualidad table this ficha técnica quotes — the salaried patrono/trabajador split behind the 11.66% global, and the 2029 escalón — is a raster image in every primary channel that publishes it, this document included (page 1 of the ficha técnica, a 765×614 JPEG): SINALEVI ficha 26485, the sesión 9038 reform ficha 89493, CCSS's own reglamento PDF, acta 9038 and the official La Gaceta 161 / Alcance 191 del 2019-08-28 all read «…se realizará con la siguiente gradualidad:» straight into the paragraph after the table. Never cite this document for the patrono/trabajador split or the 2029 rate; the independent-worker escala it was ingested for is unaffected. Text-carrying primary source located but NOT ingested: the consulta pública propuesta in La Gaceta 62 del 2019-03-28 sets the whole table out as text, but it is the proposal, not the adopted schedule — it dates the 11.66% escalón 2025-2027 and 12.16% from 2028, where the acuerdo (rige 2020-01-01) put them at 2026-01-01→2028-12-31 and 2029-01-01. See corpus-viability §1 and #175 for the evidence. TABLE EXTRACTION (#179): the escala's own table is column-aligned text, and joining its lines into a paragraph fused «Estado» and «Art. 78» into one header label and dropped the alignment, so categories 2–5 (no Art. 78 cell) read as three values where category 1 has four — the shape a reader turns into an extra Estado contribution on top of the conjunta. `layoutTable` records the column labels a reader of the PDF sees; extraction re-emits each category as its own labelled row, and fails loudly if CCSS re-publishes the ficha with a different grid. The conjunta is the sum of the columns beside it (4.16 + 5.45 + 0.30 = 9.91), not a further charge on top of them — the document never says so in words, so an answer must read it off the row.

documents.title: CCSS — Escala contributiva de trabajadores independientes y asegurados voluntarios, Seguro de Salud
documents.notes: Salud rates by income bracket (afiliado 2.89–10.69%, conjunta 12.00% + 0.25% Estado como tal), still vigente — the 2026 adjustment touched IVM only (see ccss-escala-ivm). Same acuerdo SINALEVI carries as an image in ccss-bmc; the acta transcribes the table as text. Page-ranged because the full acta is 170 pages of unrelated Junta Directiva business — re-verify the range if CCSS re-publishes the acta. Deep link page (#134): chips land on page 104, the first page of the ingested range inside the 170-page acta. SURVEY (#199): no rail. Its two escala tables are data grids, and their wrapped rows do misorder («Más de 0.8590 SM a menos / de 2 SM» closing around the numbers) — but that is #179's shape, not this one, and labelRail reads those grids as rails and mangles them, so this document is deliberately left unflagged.

documents.title: Fijación de salarios mínimos para el sector privado (vigente 2026)
documents.notes: La Gaceta 229, Alcance 156. Supplies the SM the CCSS escalas are denominated in — Trabajadores en Ocupación No Calificada ¢373.092,30/mes, from which the vigente base mínima contributiva follows: 0.87 SM = ¢324.590 (IVM) and 0.9295 SM = ¢346.789 (SEM), both matching CCSS's published BMC. Annual churn — re-fetch each wage decree; the alcance number and page range change every year. Deep link page (#134): chips land on page 165, where the decree starts inside the alcance. SURVEY (#199): no rail. The salary lists are one-line ocupación/monto rows, which already join in reading order. Not flagged.
